translationRepairs: Later Wu Zhen was removed and made deputy campaign commander in Zhiwen's place, and Zhiwen returned to his post.
Later Wu Zhen was appointed deputy campaign commander in Zhiwen's place, and Zhiwen returned to his post.
除烏震為招討副使 appoints Wu Zhen to the post; it does not remove him.

The deputy commander An Shentong held the cavalry across the river with arms at rest and did not move; fearing failure, Zhiwen bound himself and crossed the water, renewed ties with Shentong, drove off the mutinous troops, and reported it.

The deputy commander An Shentong held the cavalry across the river with arms at rest and did not move; fearing failure, Zhiwen went in person across the water, renewed ties with Shentong, drove off the mutinous troops, and reported it.
束身渡水 describes Zhiwen's personal crossing to restore the alliance, not self-binding.
